state_president_f_w_de_klerk.name: State President F. W. de Klerk

scene.note: events declared visible to this actor are directly experienced

memories.content: De Klerk is aware of the upcoming February 1990 parliamentary session and the tradition of the State President delivering the opening address. He has not yet decided whether he will personally deliver the address, and is considering various factors including political strategy and personal preference.

The South African Parliament is scheduled to open its February 1990 session during the first week of February. Customarily, the State President delivers the opening address. The exact date of the opening has been set, but the public does not yet know whether de Klerk will personally deliver the address.
